note: Default L anchors and chroma-bell parameters for accent ramps. The anchor step (usually 500) inherits L and C from the brand's stated accent. The remainder of the ramp is derived.

allowedDrift.direction: toward next-neighbor hue on the color wheel

gamutPolicy.strategy: reduce chroma in 0.005 steps until in sRGB gamut
gamutPolicy.anchorGamutFailure: if anchor itself is out-of-gamut by >0.05 C, emit a DecompositionGap
